objective_value: <float> Total weighted completion time of all jobs, or total weight of tardy jobs, depending on which scheduling objective the instance specifies.
schedule: <dict, key: '{machine}'> Ordered list of job indices assigned to each machine, in the sequence they are processed starting from time zero (present for the weighted completion time variant; lists only on-time jobs for the tardy variant).
completion_times: <dict, key: '{job}'> Time at which each scheduled job finishes processing on its assigned machine.
tardy_jobs: <list[int]> Indices of the jobs left tardy in the weighted tardy jobs variant.
on_time_jobs: <list[int]> Indices of the jobs completed by their due dates in the weighted tardy jobs variant.
